hobby.detalle: la Pasita, fan coleccionista que abre el álbum nuevo de su grupo favorito

arte.universo: An original K-pop fandom world at night: a bright pop-up album store in a generic big-city street (no signs with letters), glass shelves full of identical pastel album boxes stamped only with the PASAS raisin-in-a-circle emblem, neon tube lights, a glowing gacha-style display, posters and standees of an original 8-member idol group. The 8 members are simple round generic characters (not the Pasita, not existing people or characters), each one identified ONLY by its own solid color: red, orange, yellow, mint, blue, purple, pink and white. Photocards are small rounded cards showing one member each on a plain background of that member's color. Palette: deep purple night, neon pink and blue, with mint as the accent color. The Pasita is a fan collector: oversized mint-green hoodie, small crossbody bag, holding a mint lightstick topped with the PASAS raisin emblem; her favorite member (her bias) is the MINT one. No text, digits, letters or logos anywhere in the image.

post:
¿Qué chance hay de que te salga la photocard de tu bias? Si el grupo tiene 8 integrantes, es 1 de 8: 12.5%. 💿

Eso es probabilidad (regla de Laplace). En PASAS cada tema se explica con lo que te gusta: videojuegos, anime, K-pop o fútbol.

La última lámina es tu acordeón: guárdala para tu examen de matemáticas.

#probabilidad #matematicas #secundaria #kpop #pasasmx
